The shape of its seeds resembles the shell of a tortoise giving rise to its name. This plant has become our great variety, very resinous with a medium-long flowering of 10 weeks, dominant sativa hybrid grows in pine form with a lot of resin being very useful today for extractions. Tosh valley sitting at the gates of the Parvati region, is at an elevation of 2400 Mtrs. Approximately. This wild cultivar can grow really tall upto 14ft. With heavey lateral branching. Apart from finishing within 12 weeks and being a super fast vegger, it features one of the most beautifully balanced pine/lemon smell mixed with native spices flavours. The plant is ideal for making extracts as it produces a healthy count of trichomes with a flavour so exlusive to this valley.
